note: Parmer County TX has no county zoning layer; Texas counties generally do not zone unincorporated land. Friona (largest city) publishes its zoning map only as a static PDF (dated 2016), no ArcGIS REST or GIS service. Bovina publishes zoning text in eCode360 only, no queryable district polygons. Parmer CAD GIS is parcels only, paid downloads otherwise. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for Parmer/Friona zoning returned nothing usable.
